text: A 'prop' is like a package being delivered from a parent component to a child. Look at the Profile component in the code. What is the name of the 'package' (prop) being passed to it?
incorrectMessage: Not quite. Take another look at inside of the Profile component in the code. The 'package' (prop) being sent to it has a specific name. Try to find that name!
correctMessage: That's right! The prop being passed to the Profile component is called 'profileData'. Props are how parent components can send data down to their children in React.

text: Now that you know what a prop is, can you tell me what component is receiving the 'profileData' prop?
incorrectMessage: Not quite. The component receiving the 'profileData' prop is a specific React component defined in the code. Try to find the name of that component!
